Search across the `notes/` directory for any references to `legacy-api.internal.corp` and migrate them to `https://api.internal.corp/v2/...` (e.g. update `https://legacy-api.internal.corp/v1/services` to `https://api.internal.corp/v2/services` and `https://legacy-api.internal.corp/v1/auth` to `https://api.internal.corp/v2/auth`).
